news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.02 (vs ₹0.03 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.02 (down from ₹0.03 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹129.9m (down 25% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹5.70m (down 25% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.4% (up from 4.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 101% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 36% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
